PR: Fix to account for booleans in Service account [closed; labels size/XS, release-note, approved, lgtm, kind/bug, dco-signoff: yes, ok-to-test, area/deploy]
### Pull Request Motivation

This [issue](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/issues/7557) highlights a bug in our service account template which is causing problems whenever someone tries to add an annotation with a boolean value. This PR is meant to fix this issue.

### Kind

/kind bug

### Release Note

```release-note
Fixing the service account template to incorporate boolean values for the annotations.
```
